property_summary: For any caller who is Owner and any nonzero ETH amount v, if the callee's fallback accepts payable calls by recording received value into its public storage, then after Owner calls Command(callee, data) paying v the reference contract always results in the callee having received v (and c's balance decreased by v), whereas the mutant that drops msg.value can leave the callee's recorded received value at 0 for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Replace adr.call{value: msg.value}(data) with a call that forwards zero value (adr.call(data)), altering behavior when msg.value is expected to be forwarded.
